source: Own measurement, 2026-11-21, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 1, 12 episodes, 2 per unit) with this build's grader (7 mm date codes at a place drawn per unit; the kit vendored from shared/robotics_grader with clear_agent_account and the value-only probe lock): the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) on Docker on the reference host (2 x AMD EPYC 9254, 96 hardware threads, Linux 5.15), five ale validate runs of this tree, the first alone and four concurrently, 12 episodes each: validate-749172dd, validate-34e25ba9, validate-84b8267b, validate-c8f3651a and validate-1c260b29, mean_episode_credit 1.0 in each (the oracle's verification.json; every unit 1.0), so the mean over 60 episodes is 1.0. Every run: 12 of 12 episodes scored, no aborts, no simulation faults, the render self-test passed, the agent account cleared in 4-5 s, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 581 of 581 counted and differing, the verify stage 1490-1501 s of the 9000 s budget. The same tree with the previous kit measured the same in five earlier runs (2026-11-20).
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored credit 1.0 in three runs over the real wire when it was selected under v3 (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json); v4 changed only the date code's visual geoms and their place (tests/NOTICE.md), and the five runs above measured the reference on the current files. full_at 0.98: the five runs showed no spread; one lane's facing lost (0.2 / 3 of one episode's credit, 0.0056 of the metric) still gives the reference reward 1.0.
